entities.name: Angus
entities.description: Holy man who witnessed an attack on Serra, carried off her dying body, and built a temple that became the Cathedral of Serra.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: Planeswalker who was attacked on the Plains of Sursi and blessed the land with her passing.

entities.name: Unnamed planeswalker
entities.description: Jealous planeswalker who attacked Serra on the Plains of Sursi.

entities.name: Plains of Sursi
entities.description: Place where Serra was attacked and died, now a sanctuary.

entities.name: Cathedral of Serra
entities.description: Temple built by Angus in Serra's honor, where Serra Angels sometimes appear.

entities.name: Song of All
entities.description: Work whose cantos 1001 to 1020, Brother Angus's Lament, were added by Angus.

events.summary: Angus distracted Serra's assailant and ran off with her dying body.
events.quote: He distracted Serra's planeswalker assailant and ran off with Serra's dying body.

events.summary: Serra blessed the land with her passing as a sanctuary against dark forces.
events.quote: Serra blessed the land with her passing

events.summary: Angus comforted Serra in her last days and built a temple in her honor, the origin of the Cathedral of Serra.
events.quote: Angus made her comfortable in her last days and built a temple in her honor

events.summary: Angus added cantos to the Song of All after Serra imparted her wisdom to him.
events.quote: He added them after Serra had imparted her wisdom to him before dying.

relations.quote: a jealous, unnamed planeswalker attack Serra on the Plains of Sursi

relations.note: He built the temple that became the Cathedral.
relations.quote: built a temple in her honor: the origins of the Cathedral of Serra
